item.description:
MCP descriptions write themselves

Store MCP descriptions are now drafted automatically right after you pick a server or change its tool scope — no Generate button to press and no progress to watch. Catalog descriptions stay as a fallback, and generated copy follows the app language.

Improved

  • Tool picker became a chip cloud — The Add MCP tool selector shows every known Store tool as one wrapping cloud of chips: toggle tools directly, spot the active selection at a glance, and read descriptions through hover help.
  • Added MCPs open in the shared inspector — Results already in your library open in the same inspector as the main MCP list, straight from the Add MCP sheet and without disturbing your selection or filters. Staged-only entries are labeled Queued, and installs still go through Preview → Apply.

Fixed

  • Store access requests work reliably — Requesting MCP Store access is now dependable: the app prepares everything automatically, shows clear Request and Check progress, and keeps the request pending until access is actually granted. Server details stay hidden until access is confirmed.
